measurement_boundary: die-side M5 signal landings with adjacent die-side grounds; no qualified I/O pad, package, board, probe, antenna or EM solution is imported
required_measurements: calibrated multi-port S-parameters at declared die-side datums over 0.1 to 6 GHz
bias sweeps with VGS and VDS recorded at the actual die-side terminals, including the LNA external-bias operating region
DC ID-VGS and ID-VDS curves and small-signal Y or S parameters with SOURCE and VSS return conditions recorded
open-short-thru-load de-embedding residual using the companion coupon
passivity and causality checks on every exported network and a stated bias/temperature/stackup/probe provenance
comparison of measured and public-model gain, capacitance, access resistance and stability over the declared validity region
required_followup: bind approved measured/model-correction data to the LNA and mixer simulations
re-run receiver noise, gain, linearity and blocker screens at the qualified RF boundary
not_proven: GF180 RF compact-model validity before measurement
qualified probe pad, ESD, package or antenna behavior
noise parameters, fT, fMAX, linearity or stability from lumped PEX alone
Wi-Fi receiver performance or IEEE 802.11 compliance
